The '''Agorn Mountain''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A part of the the western [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountain range]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established the [[Knossa Spaceport/Legends|Knossa Spaceport]] around the mountain after the founding of the city of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]] circa [[24,500 BBY]].
